chapter_name: Chapter 20: Paragraph and Diary Entry Writing
learning_objective: 🎯 [Students will learn to write well-structured paragraphs with a clear topic sentence, and express personal thoughts through the format of a Diary Entry.]
warm_up_hook: 📖 Have you ever had so many thoughts in your head that you wanted to write them all down? ✍️ Whether it's describing your favorite hobby or keeping a secret journal about your day, learning to organize your ideas is a superpower! Let's start writing.

lesson_modules.teaching_content: A paragraph is a group of sentences about ONE single idea. It needs a 'Topic Sentence' at the beginning to introduce the main idea, followed by 'Supporting Sentences' with details, and a 'Concluding Sentence' to wrap it up.
examples_or_templates: Topic Sentence: Dogs make the best pets.
Supporting Details: They are loyal, they play fetch, and they protect the house.

lesson_modules.teaching_content: A diary entry is a personal piece of writing where you record your feelings, thoughts, and events of the day. It is usually written at night, in the First Person ('I', 'my'), and in the Past Tense.
examples_or_templates: Today was the best day ever because I won the spelling bee!

lesson_modules.teaching_content: A diary entry has a specific layout: Day and Date at the top left, Time below that, a greeting like 'Dear Diary', the body of the text, and your signature or name at the bottom.

practice_mcq_quiz.question: ❓ What is the purpose of a 'Topic Sentence' in a paragraph?
❓ In which tense is a Diary Entry usually written?

subjective_practice.question: ✍️ Write a Topic Sentence for a paragraph about your favorite season.
subjective_practice.hint: State clearly which season is your favorite and why in one sentence.

subjective_practice.question: ✍️ What greeting is most commonly used at the start of a Diary Entry?
subjective_practice.hint: You treat the book like a friend. 'Dear ______,'

subjective_practice.question: ✍️ Write two supporting sentences for this Topic Sentence: 'Reading books is a wonderful habit.'
subjective_practice.hint: Give two reasons why reading is good for you.

activity_or_assignment.title: 🌙 My Secret Journal
activity_or_assignment.instructions: Write a short diary entry (50-60 words) about a funny or exciting thing that happened to you today. Don't forget to include the Day, Date, Time, and 'Dear Diary' at the top!

chapter_summary: ⭐ A paragraph focuses on one main idea, starting with a Topic Sentence.
⭐ A Diary Entry is a personal record of your day, feelings, and thoughts.
⭐ Diaries are written in the first person ('I') and mostly in the past tense.
